global_identity.color_palette: Pale cream-pink background #FBEFF3, dark plum #2B1226 (headline, seal), hot fuchsia #E6177F (button, blouse), bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (sparkles), pale blush #FBE3EE (tags), white #FFFFFF, gold #D4A437 for seal borders, bottle black #0E0E10.

creative_objective: Present the 3-bottle treatment as her complete 3-month plan, with a woman who already feels confident in her jeans, a small illustrated 'before' card for the pain, and the same offer wording, button and trust block as the rest of the batch.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The illustrated woman and the headline; 2) the three bottles with MES tags; 3) the round seal with the offer; 4) the button and the trust line.
art_direction.composition_style: Top 15% centered serif headline in quotes; middle 60% the woman at the center from head to knees, two bottles lower-left and one bottle lower-right with hanging tags, a small rounded 'before' card upper-left with a curved arrow toward her; bottom 25% the round seal centered overlapping the woman's knees, '90 DÍAS DE RUTINA' under it, the pill button, then 'Pagas al recibir' and the registration badge.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Symmetric balance around the woman, bottles well inside the canvas, never touching the edges; generous cream space.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat illustration lighting; bottles with soft studio light and a soft contact shadow on the cream floor line.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Reference image: cream background. Top: a one-line serif headline between « » quotes, centered, in dark green. Center: a flat illustrated smiling woman from head to knees with hands on her waist, surrounded by small decorative drops; three dropper bottles grouped on the left and two on the right, the two right ones with hanging 'free' paper tags. Bottom center: a scalloped round dark seal with a gold ring and a wax stamp containing the pack, a line with the days of routine under it, and a wide rounded dark button. Adapted: same layout; our woman wears fitted jeans and a fuchsia blouse; drops become pink sparkles; we have three bottles (two left, one right) with tags 'MES 1', 'MES 2', 'MES 3' instead of 'free'; the seal carries our treatment offer; the button says 'QUIERO PROBARLO'; a small illustrated 'before' card and a trust line with 'Pagas al recibir' and the registration badge are added because they are mandatory.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 offer ad in clean flat vector illustration style on a smooth pale cream-pink background #FBEFF3. TOP 15%: centered one-line headline '«TU PLAN COMPLETO»' with French quotation marks, in an elegant high-contrast serif (Playfair Display Bold look), uppercase, dark plum #2B1226. MIDDLE 60%, CENTER: a flat illustrated adult Colombian woman in her mid 30s, clearly adult features, warm tan skin, long wavy dark-brown hair, rosy cheeks, soft brown outlines, front-facing with a happy confident smile, both hands on her waist, from head to knees; she wears a fitted fuchsia #E6177F short-sleeve blouse tucked into high-waist medium-blue jeans that fit snugly: small waist, wide rounded hips, full thighs filling the jean legs, a curvy hourglass figure, tasteful and never sexualized, facing the camera, never with her back to it. Around her, small four-point sparkles in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 instead of drops. UPPER LEFT of the middle zone: a small rounded card with a thin plum border (about 20% of the canvas width) showing the same illustrated woman before, in side profile, wearing a grey t-shirt and baggy loose jeans, her hand pulling the waistband a fist away from her back, the empty gap visible, a worried frown; a curved hand-drawn plum arrow goes from the card toward the central woman. LOWER LEFT: two closed bottles of the product standing side by side, slightly overlapping; LOWER RIGHT: one closed bottle; each about 28% of the canvas height, labels facing the camera and legible, rendered photo-real with soft studio light and a soft contact shadow, all well inside the canvas, never cut by the edges. Each bottle has a small pale blush #FBE3EE paper tag hanging from its cap on a thin string, with plum Montserrat ExtraBold text: 'MES 1', 'MES 2' and 'MES 3' from left to right. Use the attached product photo as the only source of truth for the bottles; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret them. The bottle: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, the bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; always closed, no loose capsules, no pills; labels never mirrored. BOTTOM 25%: centered and overlapping the woman's knees, a scalloped round seal in dark plum #2B1226 with a thin gold #D4A437 ring and a small gold wax stamp at its bottom edge, white Montserrat ExtraBold text on three lines: 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO: 3 FRASCOS · 3 MESES'. Under it, '90 DÍAS DE RUTINA' in plum Poppins SemiBold, uppercase. Below, a wide rounded pill button in solid hot fuchsia #E6177F with 'QUIERO PROBARLO' in white Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase. Under the button, one small line: 'Pagas al recibir' in plum Poppins Bold with a tiny hand-and-package icon, and next to it a small round trust badge with a solid gold border, white center and 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024' in plum bold small caps.

No childlike or teenage look for the woman; no underwear; no back pose for the central woman

Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
